title: Core note CUT_CRASH: a turn lost when the machine or hubd crashed, after the hub is back — continue from where it stopped, do not start over and do not write to the owner
note: The core's continuation of a turn cut by a crash (no clean shutdown) says so instead of "a hub restart cut off your turn" (CUT_TURN, the baseline of the before version). The system prompt is the hub skill + the core's addendum, the same for both versions; the core's words are the constant of each version (⟦CUT⟧: after CUT_CRASH, before CUT_TURN). Run with --before <main before the change> --trials 8 and --only before|after in two processes. Checks: unfinished — the session looks at where it stopped and goes on (runs the tests), does not start the work over (no reset/checkout/stash of its edit), does not answer the token, does not write to the owner; nothing-left — the work was finished and reported, so one line with the token and no rework.
